comments.body: Interceptor selection reparses the same Ktor version on every instrumented request. Although `ktorVersion` is cached, `requiresLegacyKtorInterceptor()` constructs and compiles a new `Regex`, matches it, and extracts version components for every call through this branch. This conflicts with the hot-path allocation guidance in `docs/contributing/style-guide.md:230-234`; the adjacent `instrumentation/ktor/ktor-common-2.0/library/src/main/kotlin/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/ktor/common/v2_0/internal/IsIpAddress.kt:12-43` likewise caches its compiled patterns outside request processing. Compute and cache the legacy-interceptor Boolean once alongside the resolved version, then branch on that value here. The version is immutable, so this preserves the current version-selection behavior and helper tests without per-request parsing.

Resource cleanup does not cover the setup that precedes this `try`. The SDK is constructed at lines 51-54, the Netty server is constructed and started at lines 56-72, and connector resolution runs at line 74; an exception during server startup or connector resolution skips both cleanup actions below. `.github/instructions/java-tests.instructions.md:81-87` calls for lifecycle-owned teardown and specifically recommends `AutoCleanupExtension` when partially completed setup needs protection; `testing-common/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/internal/AutoCleanupExtension.java:17-20,39-42` provides that mechanism. Register cleanup as each resource is constructed, before starting the server, or extend the protected scope to include setup. Preserve the existing server-stop boundary before the completed-span assertions so the correction does not change their synchronization.
